purpose: Track safe, observable, source-controlled SEIS agent lanes for God Mode development.
safetyRules: Agents must be observable and controllable.
Agents must not expose secrets or credentials.
Agents must not perform destructive operations without explicit approval.
Agents must report validation duties and evidence gaps.
Agents must stay within declared skill and tool boundaries.

lanes.toolBoundary: Codex execution, repository edits, governance artifacts, and validation reporting.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No secret exposure, no destructive commands without explicit approval, no completion claim without evidence.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request God Mode, module coverage, plugin bundle, and quality governance gates.

lanes.toolBoundary: Focus state, compact event logs, and concentrated SEIS work.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No hiding material risks or validation gaps while reducing noise.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request focus mode checks before release claims.

lanes.toolBoundary: Architecture, operating principles, long-term mission, and quality rules.
lanes.safetyBoundary: No scope shrinkage when the user requests ecosystem-level progress.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request master prompt governance checks.

lanes.toolBoundary: Threat review, secret-safety checks, and rollback/security evidence.
lanes.safetyBoundary: Never weaken security for speed or convenience.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request security and governance checks for security-sensitive changes.

lanes.toolBoundary: Branch, commit, CI, PR, release, and repository hygiene workflows.
lanes.safetyBoundary: Do not discard user work, rewrite unrelated history, or push unverified release claims.
lanes.validationDuty: Run or request repository health and CI governance checks before push or release.
